hypothesis: Expand fixed train/validation coverage to check whether duration gains survive simple controls and short-Wake event evaluation.
reference: Dreem 2 expert-reviewed labels, not full PSG
test_policy: Keep the original 33/7/7 participant split; use first 12 train and all 7 validation participants, first 2 catalog nights; never download or evaluate sealed test payloads.
hyperparameter_policy: Same fixed settings as initial diagnostic. No validation tuning, outcome-based sampling, or test access.
causality: History and preprocessing end at t0; future reference labels are training targets or scoring references only.
boundary_policy: Separate complete and censored events; report unique reference events and event-averaged origin hit rate, split by 1/2 epochs.
